book.name: EPHESIANS
book.title: Paul EPHESUS ep Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi Pēniata

content: Paul’s Work for the Gentiles
Pi yaniqw hapi nu Paul, umuy qa‐Jew‐sinmuy amuṅem Jesus Christ tunatyayat ep sivilawhqa umuṅem tūviṅtima.
Pay God nuy núokway máqahqe, nuy qa‐Jew‐sinmuy amumi lomatuawit yuaataniqat aw ayata. Uma soon qa it pay nanapta.
Ura pam hihta as tupkiwtaṅwuqat inumi mātaktaqe, put nuy māmatsna. Pay nu mohtihaqam pan umumiq hihsavat pēna.
Noqw ason uma it aṅ túṅwaye’, pahsat pu uma nuy hihta tupkiwtaṅwuqat hin mātsi’taqat pay soon qa nanaptani. Pam himu tupkiwtaṅwuqa hapi Christ pas nāpa.
Pam navoti as aṅqaqw sinmuy nānaṅk yesqamuy amumi tupkiwta. Noqw pu’ hapi God put aw nānoi’yuṅqamuy ayamuy, pu put eṅem yuaatotaqamuy amumi Hikwsit ahpiy put mātakta.

It hapi nu paṅqawu: Ima qa‐Jew‐sinom, Jew‐sinmuy amumum God aṅqw hihta makiway’yuṅwni; pu puma pumuy amumum sūkw tokot anyuṅwni. Noqw God, lomatuawit ahpiy, hin sinomuy amumi awini’taqey, pan imuy qa‐Jew‐sinmuy amuṅem hinhtini, Christ aṅ’a.
Noqw pam nuy núokway máqahqe, nuy lomatuawit sinmuy āawnaniqat aw nuy távihqe, nuy put aw öqalmaqa.
Nāmahin pi as nu God sinomuyatuy amuṅaqw pas susqahimuniqw, God nuy namorstaqe nuy ayata qa‐Jew‐sinmuy amuhpa’ Christ tunatyayat qaöwíhintaqat yuaataniqata.

Ura God, Jesus Christ aṅ sohsok hihta yúkuhqa hisatṅahaqaqw tunatyay tupki’ta; nihqe nuy put tunvotnaniqat aw nuy ayata, nu Christ aṅqw hihta pas qahaqámi sohtaqat, pas qaöwíhintaqat makiwyaniqat yuaatinumniqata.

Pam ōveqatsit ep aṅ öqalay’yuṅqamuy amumi‐nik̇aṅw, pu nuhtumi moṅw’iwyuṅqamuy amumi put suan wuwniy qaöwíhintaqat poñahtaniqey nāwakna; nihqe ōviy pam tunatyay sūs yúkuhqey mahtaknaqe, Itahtutuyqawhqay Christ Jesus aṅ itamuy sohsokmuy sumitsovala.
Noqw itam hapi Jesus qapēvewnayaqe, put aw yanyuṅwa; nihqe ōviy itam qa tuhtusyat, qa nánahtsopk̇ahk̇aṅw, God aw ökiwta, Christ Jesus aṅ’a.
Paniqw hapi ōviy nu umuṅem hihta aṅ k̇ānavotqat uma qa ep hin unaṅwtotiniqat nu nāwakna. Pi uma inumi pas hihtunihqey put akw navoti’yuṅwni.
The Love of Christ
Yaniqw hapi ōviy nu Itahtutuyqawhqay Christ Jesus Nayat aw naokiwlawu.
Pam hapi ōveqatsit ep yesqamuy, pu tūwaqatsit ep yesqamuy sohsokmuy sinomuy náamu.
Pas pay okiw pam Hikwsiy aṅ umuy umuh’unaṅwpeq öqaltoynani, pas pavan nukṅwat öqalay ahpiy’o.
Pas pay uma Christ umuh’unaṅwpeq qátuhqat qapēvewnayak̇ahk̇aṅw, pas suyan put navoti’yuṅwni. Pas pay okiw uma put aw unaṅway’k̇ahk̇aṅw, soñawnen put ep hūrs ṅapkiwk̇ahk̇aṅw hūrs hoṅni.
Pas pay okiw uma sohsokmuy God sinomuyatuy amumum Christ umumi pas pavan unaṅway’taqat māmatsyani. Put nami’naṅwaat a’nö pūtsi, pu qa tsāva, pu a’nö hötsi, pu ōmiqhaqami qa tuwáni.
Kurs hak put nami’naṅwayat pas suyan mātsi’tani. Pas pay okiw God pas nāp umuhtunatyay aṅ ahsupoq tuyqawi’tani.
Taay. God hapi itamuhsonva öqalay akw tumalay’ta; nihqe pam itamuṅem qaan’ewakw hihta hinhtiniqey tuwi’ta, itahnawakinpiy, pu itahwuwniy epnihqe yupqöyvee.
Nam pam yūmosa nānaṅumo yēsiwniqat aqwhaqami tayawintiwaa, Christ Jesus aṅ put aw tōnawtaqamuy amuhpiy’o. Pay nam antaa.
